review_type: Author mathematical, instructional and numerical review; no independent specialist certification
chapter_scope: v02-c07 and v02-c08 only; Volume 2 remains in production

v02-c07.reasoning: Checked multivariable-limit quantifiers, partial versus total differentiability, continuous-partial sufficiency through coordinate increments, continuous counterexample with nonlinear directional responses, gradient geometry and units, Jacobian dimensions/chain order, continuous mixed-partial conditions, vector Taylor remainder, local implicit/inverse-function hypotheses and differentiation of a chosen equilibrium branch.
v02-c07.arithmetic: Quadratic levels and increments, gradient-direction products, Hessian eigenvalues, production responses, inverse Jacobian products, substituted chain derivative and both equilibrium systems independently recomputed. Nonlinear solutions cross-checked by bisection rather than relying only on the printed root expression.
v02-c07.instruction: Defines domains, balls, level sets, gradients, Jacobians and Hessians before their use. Gives both partial-derivative and all-directional-derivative failure examples. Local branch existence is distinguished from formal differentiation and global uniqueness; general existence proof is explicitly deferred to later analysis methods.
v02-c07.solutions: All eight prompts have corresponding complete calculations and counterexamples. Input/output orders, positivity restrictions and coordinate changes are explicit. Taylor prediction errors are checked against the original function.

v02-c08.reasoning: Checked local/global/strict optimality distinctions, compact/coercive existence claims, interior first- and second-order conditions, concavity tangent bounds and uniqueness, regular equality tangent geometry, KKT signs under one fixed convention, feasibility/complementarity, LICQ necessity, convex sufficiency proof, Slater domain/attainment assumptions, constrained Lagrangian curvature and regime-qualified envelope derivatives.
v02-c08.arithmetic: Log allocation, benefit value and resource derivative; quadratic corner/interior/slack regimes; all KKT multipliers and residuals; changed-benefit exercises; constrained quadratic equality; box constraint; circle extrema; and transition-value calculations independently recomputed using exact fractions or elementary numerical evaluations.
v02-c08.instruction: Does not infer optimality from stationarity alone. States necessary and sufficient conditions separately, demonstrates a true optimum without KKT multipliers, explains active constraints with zero multipliers, and restricts smooth envelope reasoning to regular regimes. Uses original allocations with explicit objective units.
v02-c08.solutions: All eight exercises have calculations plus the relevant global certificate, tangent test or qualification critique. Boundary and degenerate cases receive their own arguments.

shared_review.sources: Official MIT multivariable unit pages and implicit-function lecture PDF retrieved. Stanford authors duality slides and Yinyu Ye review notes retrieved for specialist condition checks and further study. The full Convex Optimization book PDF timed out; no claim of reading it is made. All problems and synthetic numerical examples are original.
shared_review.structure: Two worked examples, eight exercises and matching solutions per chapter; explicit scope, assumptions, teach-back, delayed check and method-specific source routes. HTML build checks local links, anchors, source IDs and the prerequisite graph.
shared_review.numerical_scope: check_v02_optimization.py checks determinate examples and exercises, original-function responses, equilibrium roots and KKT identities. Finite calculations do not prove quantified theorems; analytic arguments and hypotheses were reviewed separately.
